canonical_statement: The path to the divine city is fraught with existential dangers that target specific worldly attachments held by the traveler.

attributions.chapter: THE ACTS OF PETER A ND THE TWELVE APOSTLES ( V I ,7 )
attributions.surface_quote: The one who carries bread... the black dogs kill because of the bread.

canonical_statement: The ultimate spiritual reality is freely given by the divine, but only accessible to those who have undergone rigorous purification.

attributions.chapter: THE ACTS OF PETER A ND THE TWELVE APOSTLES ( V I ,7 )
attributions.surface_quote: I may not only show you it, but give it to you for nothing.

canonical_statement: The divine name functions as a source of ontological power and strength for the practitioner.

attributions.chapter: THE ACTS OF PETER A ND THE TWELVE APOSTLES ( V I ,7 )
attributions.surface_quote: He is a great power for giving strength.

canonical_statement: The structure of the spiritual city consists of nine gates, with a tenth element serving as the governing head.

attributions.chapter: THE ACTS OF PETER A ND THE TWELVE APOSTLES ( V I ,7 )
attributions.surface_quote: This is the name of my city, ‘Nine Gates.’ ... the tenth is the head.

canonical_statement: The attainment of the kingdom of heaven is contingent upon the endurance of earthly trials and faith.

attributions.chapter: THE ACTS OF PETER A ND THE TWELVE APOSTLES ( V I ,7 )
attributions.surface_quote: everyone who endures his trials... a precious kingdom comes from them

canonical_statement: Spiritual liberation is achieved by shedding worldly desires and attachments, rendering one invisible to lower-order predatory forces.

attributions.chapter: THE ACTS OF PETER A ND THE TWELVE APOSTLES ( V I ,7 )
attributions.surface_quote: We evaded the robbers... because they did not find their garments with us.

canonical_statement: The divine entity possesses the capacity to alter its manifest appearance to interact with human consciousness.

attributions.chapter: THE ACTS OF PETER A ND THE TWELVE APOSTLES ( V I ,7 )
attributions.surface_quote: Lithargoel, having changed, came out to us. He had the appearance of a physician.

canonical_statement: The divine nature is not universally accessible and remains hidden from those who lack specific spiritual orientation.

attributions.chapter: THE ACTS OF PETER A ND THE TWELVE APOSTLES ( V I ,7 )
attributions.surface_quote: he does not reveal himself to every man, because he himself is the son of a great king.

canonical_statement: The divine entity can adopt a physical form or garment to interact with humanity.

attributions.chapter: THE ACTS OF PETER A ND THE TWELVE APOSTLES ( V I ,7 )
attributions.surface_quote: He loosened the garment, which clothed him... revealing to us in truth that it was he.

canonical_statement: Spiritual wisdom and the divine name possess greater intrinsic value than material wealth.

attributions.chapter: THE ACTS OF PETER A ND THE TWELVE APOSTLES ( V I ,7 )
attributions.surface_quote: My name... surpasses all riches, and the wisdom of God surpasses gold.

canonical_statement: There is a categorical distinction between worldly healing of the body and the spiritual healing of the heart.

attributions.chapter: THE ACTS OF PETER A ND THE TWELVE APOSTLES ( V I ,7 )
attributions.surface_quote: Physicians of this world heal what belongs to the world. The physicians of souls heal the heart.

canonical_statement: Spiritual authority possesses the capacity to heal internal, non-physical ailments of the human heart.

attributions.chapter: THE ACTS OF PETER A ND THE TWELVE APOSTLES ( V I ,7 )
attributions.surface_quote: you have power to heal the illnesses of the heart also.

canonical_statement: Social partiality toward the wealthy is a form of spiritual corruption that facilitates further sin.

attributions.chapter: THE ACTS OF PETER A ND THE TWELVE APOSTLES ( V I ,7 )
attributions.surface_quote: many in the churches have shown partiality to the rich... they give occasion for others to sin.

canonical_statement: The ultimate nature of the Divine or the Self is characterized by the simultaneous embodiment of contradictory and antithetical qualities.

attributions.chapter: THE ACTS OF PETER A ND THE TWELVE APOSTLES ( V I ,7 )
attributions.surface_quote: I am death, I am life. I am darkness, I am light.

canonical_statement: The divine essence encompasses all binary opposites and contradictory states of existence.

attributions.chapter: THE ACTS OF PETER A ND THE TWELVE APOSTLES ( V I ,7 )
attributions.surface_quote: Death am I and deathlessness, What is not and that which is.

canonical_statement: The divine presence manifests in the material world as an intelligent, pervasive force.

attributions.chapter: THE ACTS OF PETER A ND THE TWELVE APOSTLES ( V I ,7 )
attributions.surface_quote: Perfect Mind, meaning the extension of the divine into the world.

canonical_statement: A singular intelligent principle permeates all worldly divisions and dichotomies.

attributions.chapter: THE ACTS OF PETER A ND THE TWELVE APOSTLES ( V I ,7 )
attributions.surface_quote: Spanning all worldly divisions and dichotomies and responsible for everything that occurs.

canonical_statement: There exists a transcendent power that originates above the immanent divine mind.

attributions.chapter: THE ACTS OF PETER A ND THE TWELVE APOSTLES ( V I ,7 )
attributions.surface_quote: It speaks of a power above Perfect Mind.

canonical_statement: The ultimate consciousness is a singular, non-dual entity that encompasses all contradictory opposites and binary roles.

attributions.chapter: THE ACTS OF PETER A ND THE TWELVE APOSTLES ( V I ,7 )
attributions.surface_quote: I am the honored one and the scorned one. I am the whore and the holy one.

canonical_statement: The ultimate consciousness exists as the source, the offspring, and the progenitor of itself simultaneously.

attributions.chapter: THE ACTS OF PETER A ND THE TWELVE APOSTLES ( V I ,7 )
attributions.surface_quote: I am the mother of my father... and he is my offspring.

canonical_statement: The ultimate consciousness is eternal and transcends the linear progression of time.

attributions.chapter: THE ACTS OF PETER A ND THE TWELVE APOSTLES ( V I ,7 )
attributions.surface_quote: I am the first and the last.

canonical_statement: The ultimate consciousness is accessible and present to those who actively seek and contemplate it.

attributions.chapter: THE ACTS OF PETER A ND THE TWELVE APOSTLES ( V I ,7 )
attributions.surface_quote: I have been found among those who seek after me.

canonical_statement: The ultimate reality encompasses and reconciles all binary opposites and contradictory states of being.

attributions.chapter: THE ACTS OF PETER A ND THE TWELVE APOSTLES ( V I ,7 )
attributions.surface_quote: I am knowledge and ignorance. I am shame and boldness.

canonical_statement: The divine identity is fundamentally incomprehensible and transcends human conceptualization.

attributions.chapter: THE ACTS OF PETER A ND THE TWELVE APOSTLES ( V I ,7 )
attributions.surface_quote: I am the silence that is incomprehensible.

canonical_statement: The divine presence is manifested within the lowest and most disgraced aspects of material existence.

attributions.chapter: THE ACTS OF PETER A ND THE TWELVE APOSTLES ( V I ,7 )
attributions.surface_quote: Do not look upon me on the dung-heap.

canonical_statement: The nature of the divine is characterized by a paradoxical unity of opposing moral and physical attributes.

attributions.chapter: THE ACTS OF PETER A ND THE TWELVE APOSTLES ( V I ,7 )
attributions.surface_quote: I am compassionate and I am cruel.

canonical_statement: The ultimate reality encompasses and transcends all binary opposites and contradictory states.

attributions.chapter: THE ACTS OF PETER A ND THE TWELVE APOSTLES ( V I ,7 )
attributions.surface_quote: I am senseless and I am wise. I am weak and I am strong.

canonical_statement: The divine essence is the underlying substrate of all human perceptions, including those labeled as opposites.

attributions.chapter: THE ACTS OF PETER A ND THE TWELVE APOSTLES ( V I ,7 )
attributions.surface_quote: I am the one whom they call Life, and you have called Death.

canonical_statement: Human judgment and categorization are subjective distortions of a singular, unified truth.

attributions.chapter: THE ACTS OF PETER A ND THE TWELVE APOSTLES ( V I ,7 )
attributions.surface_quote: I am the one whom you have pursued, and I am the one whom you have seized.

canonical_statement: The divine presence is simultaneously immanent within all cultural and social constructs and transcendent of them.

attributions.chapter: THE ACTS OF PETER A ND THE TWELVE APOSTLES ( V I ,7 )
attributions.surface_quote: I am the wisdom of the Greeks and the knowledge of the barbarians.

canonical_statement: The divine presence exists in a reciprocal, inverse relationship with human perception, appearing when the human hides and hiding when the human appears.

attributions.chapter: THE ACTS OF PETER A ND THE TWELVE APOSTLES ( V I ,7 )
attributions.surface_quote: whenever you hide yourselves, I myself will appear.

canonical_statement: Greatness and smallness are interdependent categories; the nature of the great is defined by and known through the small.

attributions.chapter: THE ACTS OF PETER A ND THE TWELVE APOSTLES ( V I ,7 )
attributions.surface_quote: the smallnesses are known from the greatnesses.

canonical_statement: The ultimate reality functions as the foundational mind, the source of inquiry, and the power behind all angelic and cosmic operations.

attributions.chapter: THE ACTS OF PETER A ND THE TWELVE APOSTLES ( V I ,7 )
attributions.surface_quote: I am the mind... the knowledge of my inquiry, and the power of the powers.

canonical_statement: The divine identity encompasses contradictory human experiences, including shame and shamelessness, as aspects of its own members.

attributions.chapter: THE ACTS OF PETER A ND THE TWELVE APOSTLES ( V I ,7 )
attributions.surface_quote: out of shame, take me to yourselves shamelessly; and out of shamelessness and shame, upbraid my members.

canonical_statement: The ultimate reality encompasses all contradictory states and dualities simultaneously.

attributions.chapter: THE ACTS OF PETER A ND THE TWELVE APOSTLES ( V I ,7 )
attributions.surface_quote: I am the substance and the one who has no substance.

canonical_statement: Knowledge of the divine is inversely related to perceived proximity.

attributions.chapter: THE ACTS OF PETER A ND THE TWELVE APOSTLES ( V I ,7 )
attributions.surface_quote: Those who are close to me have been ignorant of me.

canonical_statement: The divine source is the origin of both moral opposites, such as sin and sinlessness.

attributions.chapter: THE ACTS OF PETER A ND THE TWELVE APOSTLES ( V I ,7 )
attributions.surface_quote: I am sinless, and the root of sin derives from me.

canonical_statement: The divine essence is the underlying substrate of all individual souls and spirits.

attributions.chapter: THE ACTS OF PETER A ND THE TWELVE APOSTLES ( V I ,7 )
attributions.surface_quote: spirits of every man who exists with me

canonical_statement: The divine nature is inherently paradoxical, manifesting as both the controller and the uncontrollable.

attributions.chapter: THE ACTS OF PETER A ND THE TWELVE APOSTLES ( V I ,7 )
attributions.surface_quote: I am control and the uncontrollable.

canonical_statement: The judge and the capacity for judgment are internal to the individual.

attributions.chapter: THE ACTS OF PETER A ND THE TWELVE APOSTLES ( V I ,7 )
attributions.surface_quote: the judge and partiality exist in you

canonical_statement: The internal and external realities are identical in essence and origin.

attributions.chapter: THE ACTS OF PETER A ND THE TWELVE APOSTLES ( V I ,7 )
attributions.surface_quote: what is inside of you is what is outside of you

canonical_statement: The material world is a manifestation or garment of the internal self.

attributions.chapter: THE ACTS OF PETER A ND THE TWELVE APOSTLES ( V I ,7 )
attributions.surface_quote: what you see outside of you, you see inside of you; it is your garment

canonical_statement: The ultimate consciousness is the singular, unconditioned source of all existence.

attributions.chapter: THE ACTS OF PETER A ND THE TWELVE APOSTLES ( V I ,7 )
attributions.surface_quote: I am the one who alone exists

canonical_statement: Human existence involves a cycle of delusion through passions followed by a return to a permanent state of being.

attributions.chapter: THE ACTS OF PETER A ND THE TWELVE APOSTLES ( V I ,7 )
attributions.surface_quote: embrace fleeting pleasures until they become sober and go up to their resting-place

canonical_statement: The soul originates from a divine source, undergoes a descent into the material world, and achieves victory over materiality.

attributions.chapter: THE ACTS OF PETER A ND THE TWELVE APOSTLES ( V I ,7 )
attributions.surface_quote: exposition of the origin, condition, and ultimate destiny of the soul.

canonical_statement: The material world is fundamentally separate from and antithetical to the divine realm.

attributions.chapter: THE ACTS OF PETER A ND THE TWELVE APOSTLES ( V I ,7 )
attributions.surface_quote: presuppose a generally gnostic, i.e., anticosmic dualist, understanding

canonical_statement: Humanity is categorized into distinct groups based on their capacity for spiritual discernment and awareness of truth.

attributions.chapter: THE ACTS OF PETER A ND THE TWELVE APOSTLES ( V I ,7 )
attributions.surface_quote: polemic against the senseless who are distinguished from the we and the pagans

canonical_statement: Ignorance serves as a mitigating factor for the spiritual state of those outside the community of the enlightened.

attributions.chapter: THE ACTS OF PETER A ND THE TWELVE APOSTLES ( V I ,7 )
attributions.surface_quote: pagans, who are more or less excusable on grounds of ignorance

canonical_statement: The material world is inherently evil or corrupt.

attributions.surface_quote: emphasis on the evil character of the material world

canonical_statement: The spiritual soul originates from a heavenly realm.

attributions.surface_quote: heavenly origin of the spiritual soul

canonical_statement: Gnosis or revealed knowledge is the necessary mechanism for salvation.

attributions.surface_quote: role of revealed knowledge as salvific

canonical_statement: The soul exists in a state of constant vulnerability to external adversarial forces.

attributions.surface_quote: soul is in perpetual danger of succumbing to the adversary

canonical_statement: Human identity may be composed of two distinct souls: a spiritual soul and a rational soul.

attributions.surface_quote: distinctive Middle Platonic doctrine of two souls (spiritual and rational)

canonical_statement: The soul originates from invisible, ineffable realms and maintains an ontological connection to them regardless of its descent into lower states.

attributions.surface_quote: Whether she is in the descent or is in the Pleroma, she is not separated.

canonical_statement: Perception of one's divine origin and spiritual kin requires a transformative, medicinal intervention upon the mind.

attributions.surface_quote: He applied the word to her eyes as a medicine to make her see.

canonical_statement: The soul's ultimate purpose is to recognize its root and renounce material existence to reclaim its original nature.

attributions.surface_quote: Learn about her root... in order that she might receive what is hers and renounce matter.

canonical_statement: Spiritual lineage is defined by derivation from a divine seed rather than biological descent.

attributions.surface_quote: Those who have come from his seed, call the sons of the woman.

canonical_statement: The human soul is ontologically distinct from the body and material passions, which are considered external to its true nature.

attributions.surface_quote: the spiritual soul was cast into the body, it became a brother to lust

canonical_statement: Human existence is defined by a fundamental choice between life and death, which determines the soul's trajectory.

attributions.surface_quote: death and life are set before everyone. Whichever of these two they wish

canonical_statement: The soul's descent into material pleasure and ignorance results in the loss of memory regarding its divine origin.

attributions.surface_quote: she does not remember her brothers and her father, for pleasure and sweet profits deceive her

canonical_statement: The Father existed as a singular, transcendent reality prior to the manifestation of all worlds, authorities, and powers.

attributions.surface_quote: before anything came into being, it was the Father alone who existed

canonical_statement: All manifestation and creation are contingent upon the singular will of the Father.

attributions.surface_quote: nothing came into being without his wish

canonical_statement: The material world is a temporary testing ground designed to facilitate the soul's return to the transcendent source.

attributions.surface_quote: The Father brought about this great contest in this world to make contestants appear.

canonical_statement: True identity is derived from the Inscrutable One, and liberation is achieved through gnosis rather than material attachment.

attributions.surface_quote: We are to be victorious over their ignorance through our knowledge.

canonical_statement: The soul is inherently divine but suffers from blindness caused by immersion in material existence.

attributions.surface_quote: The soul is ill because she dwells in a house of poverty, while matter strikes blows.

canonical_statement: Spiritual knowledge acts as a medicinal light that blinds hostile material forces and restores the soul's vision.

attributions.surface_quote: She pursues the word and applies it to her eyes as a medicine.

canonical_statement: The soul's true dwelling-place is a transcendent, secure treasure-house distinct from the material realm.

attributions.surface_quote: She runs upward into her treasure-house, the one in which her mind is.

canonical_statement: The soul is a composite entity possessing both a rational, divine aspect and an irrational, material aspect.

attributions.surface_quote: The soul is composed of a rational and an irrational part.

canonical_statement: The material world functions as a deceptive construct that obscures the true nature of the divine intellect.

attributions.surface_quote: The world is a shadow that hides the true light of the intellect.

canonical_statement: Human existence is characterized by a state of ignorance regarding one's origin, which must be overcome through self-knowledge.

attributions.surface_quote: Man wanders in ignorance until he recognizes his true origin.

canonical_statement: The material world functions as a trap designed to ensnare the soul through sensory desire and worldly attachments.

attributions.surface_quote: The adversary spies on us... wishing to make us desire one of them.

canonical_statement: Attachment to worldly objects and emotions leads the soul into a state of spiritual slavery and death.

attributions.surface_quote: He may seize us with his hidden poison and bring us out of freedom.

canonical_statement: Ignorance is the primary mechanism by which the soul is deceived and bound to material existence.

attributions.surface_quote: The greatest of all these are ignorance and ease.

canonical_statement: The soul is distinct from the body and can be manipulated by fleshly desires to produce material outcomes.

attributions.surface_quote: Wishing to make the mind of the soul incline her toward one of them.

canonical_statement: The material world and its sensory experiences are transitory and deceptive.

attributions.surface_quote: sweet passions are transitory... she leaves behind those deceitful foods.

canonical_statement: The true self possesses an invisible spiritual body distinct from the physical form.

attributions.surface_quote: she has an invisible spiritual body

canonical_statement: The physical body is a construct managed by external forces that seek to control the soul.

attributions.surface_quote: dealers in bodies... endured great labors until they had shaped the body of this soul

canonical_statement: The ultimate dwelling-place of the soul exists in a state of rest.

attributions.surface_quote: their dwelling-place, which exists in rest

canonical_statement: Ignorance of the divine origin and destination of the soul constitutes the primary spiritual failure.

attributions.surface_quote: the senseless man hears the call, but he is ignorant of the place

canonical_statement: The material world and its structures are transient and subject to destruction.

attributions.surface_quote: the way to go to their stone temple, which will perish

canonical_statement: Ignorance and error function as active forces that suppress the mind's capacity for transcendence.

attributions.surface_quote: the force of ignorance and the demon of error... do not allow his mind to rise

canonical_statement: The rational soul attains knowledge of the Divine through active inquiry and endurance of bodily suffering.

attributions.surface_quote: the rational soul who wearied herself in seeking - she learned about God

canonical_statement: The ultimate state of the soul is characterized by rest, union with the Divine, and participation in immortality.

attributions.surface_quote: She came to rest in him who is at rest... She partook of the immortal food.

canonical_statement: Salvation is achieved through the cognitive apprehension of the supreme transcendent power.

attributions.surface_quote: human salvation depends upon knowing our great power

canonical_statement: The material realm is inherently excluded from the process of salvation.

attributions.surface_quote: contemplates the salvation of nothing material

canonical_statement: History is structured into distinct, sequential aeons characterized by different ontological states.

attributions.surface_quote: the tractate divides all history into three aeons

canonical_statement: The destruction of the material universe serves as a purifying mechanism for the soul.

attributions.surface_quote: the fire consumes matter, it purifies souls

canonical_statement: The supreme deity exists in a state of transcendence above all demiurgic or fleshly powers.

attributions.surface_quote: He is transcendent and above all powers

canonical_statement: Knowledge of the divine Power confers immunity to physical destruction and invisibility to material forces.

attributions.surface_quote: He who will know our great Power will become invisible, and fire will not consume.

canonical_statement: The material possessions and worldly works of the individual must be purged and destroyed to achieve spiritual integration.

attributions.surface_quote: their thoughts and their works may be ended, that they may be purged.

canonical_statement: The ultimate destination of the soul is a transcendent realm that is imperceptible to the uninitiated.

attributions.surface_quote: gathered in the place which no one in it sees.

canonical_statement: Individual identity is inscribed and preserved within a primordial light through the agency of the Great Power.

attributions.surface_quote: he may inscribe your name in our great light.

canonical_statement: The ultimate source is the necessary foundation for the existence of all aeons and created beings.

attributions.chapter: THE CONCEPT OF OUR GREAT POWER ( V I ,4 )
attributions.surface_quote: it is not possible for anyone to stand without that One

canonical_statement: The human soul is a replica or image of a higher divine Power.

attributions.chapter: THE CONCEPT OF OUR GREAT POWER ( V I ,4 )
attributions.surface_quote: the soul became its replica

canonical_statement: The physical realm and the flesh are secondary, derived states that obscure the perception of the divine.

attributions.chapter: THE CONCEPT OF OUR GREAT POWER ( V I ,4 )
attributions.surface_quote: before it comes into being it does not see, because the aeon of the flesh

canonical_statement: The divine Power sustains and nourishes all beings, including gods and angels, by moving them into permanent states of existence.

attributions.chapter: THE CONCEPT OF OUR GREAT POWER ( V I ,4 )
attributions.surface_quote: he moves them from the aeon and nourishes them in the permanent places

canonical_statement: The material world is subject to cycles of judgment and destruction, while the work of the divine Power remains immutable.

attributions.chapter: THE CONCEPT OF OUR GREAT POWER ( V I ,4 )
attributions.surface_quote: Only the work of the Power stood up

canonical_statement: The psychic aeon is characterized by the entanglement of souls with material bodies and the subsequent generation of negative emotional and moral states.

attributions.chapter: THE CONCEPT OF OUR GREAT POWER ( V I ,4 )
attributions.surface_quote: The psychic aeon is mixed with bodies, begetting in the souls and defiling them.

canonical_statement: Material existence is a state of unconsciousness comparable to dreaming, from which the soul must awaken to attain true sustenance.

attributions.chapter: THE CONCEPT OF OUR GREAT POWER ( V I ,4 )
attributions.surface_quote: You are sleeping, dreaming dreams. Wake up and return, taste and eat the true food.

canonical_statement: Fire functions as a purifying agent that consumes matter and wickedness until it eventually exhausts its fuel and self-destructs.

attributions.chapter: THE CONCEPT OF OUR GREAT POWER ( V I ,4 )
attributions.surface_quote: The fire will burn matter until it has cleansed everything, then it will destroy itself.

canonical_statement: The enlightened being possesses a nature that transcends material capture and possesses the power to abolish the laws of the current aeon.

attributions.chapter: THE CONCEPT OF OUR GREAT POWER ( V I ,4 )
attributions.surface_quote: The nature of his flesh could not be seized; his word has abolished the law.

canonical_statement: The material world is governed by archons whose judgments and actions ultimately result in their own condemnation.

attributions.chapter: THE CONCEPT OF OUR GREAT POWER ( V I ,4 )
attributions.surface_quote: They brought judgment upon themselves and delivered him up to the ruler of Hades.

canonical_statement: The manifestation of higher consciousness signals the dissolution of the archontic structures and the transition between aeons.

attributions.chapter: THE CONCEPT OF OUR GREAT POWER ( V I ,4 )
attributions.surface_quote: They did not know that this is the sign of their dissolution.

canonical_statement: Knowledge of the truth regarding the aeonic cycle grants the individual a state of blessedness and rest in the heavens.

attributions.chapter: THE CONCEPT OF OUR GREAT POWER ( V I ,4 )
attributions.surface_quote: They will come to know the truth. For you have found rest in the heavens.

canonical_statement: Aeons are temporal structures that undergo cycles of creation, duration, and eventual dissolution.

attributions.chapter: THE CONCEPT OF OUR GREAT POWER ( V I ,4 )
attributions.surface_quote: The first aeon perished in the course of time.

canonical_statement: Human beings possess the potential to transcend their current state and become indestructible aeons.

attributions.chapter: THE CONCEPT OF OUR GREAT POWER ( V I ,4 )
attributions.surface_quote: How will they become indestructible aeons?

canonical_statement: The manifestation of the Logos serves as a temporal marker for the initiation of cosmic events.

attributions.chapter: THE CONCEPT OF OUR GREAT POWER ( V I ,4 )
attributions.surface_quote: the East, i.e., that place where the Logos appeared at first.

canonical_statement: The progression of time is finite and leads to a predetermined conclusion.

attributions.chapter: THE CONCEPT OF OUR GREAT POWER ( V I ,4 )
attributions.surface_quote: when the times were completed

canonical_statement: The archonic power operates as a force of entropy or deception within the material realm.

attributions.chapter: THE CONCEPT OF OUR GREAT POWER ( V I ,4 )
attributions.surface_quote: the archon of the western regions... will instruct men in his wickedness.

canonical_statement: The material world and its governing powers are subject to a predetermined temporal cycle.

attributions.chapter: THE CONCEPT OF OUR GREAT POWER ( V I ,4 )
attributions.surface_quote: When he has completed the established time of the kingdom of the earth

canonical_statement: The soul's liberation involves withdrawal from the material realm into an immeasurable light beyond physical constraints.

attributions.chapter: THE CONCEPT OF OUR GREAT POWER ( V I ,4 )
attributions.surface_quote: I shall withdraw with everyone who will know me into the immeasurable light.

canonical_statement: Material existence is characterized by a state of impurity that requires purification through suffering or fire.

attributions.chapter: THE CONCEPT OF OUR GREAT POWER ( V I ,4 )
attributions.surface_quote: They will be chastised until they become pure.

canonical_statement: The material universe is a temporary construct destined for dissolution and non-existence.

attributions.chapter: THE CONCEPT OF OUR GREAT POWER ( V I ,4 )
attributions.surface_quote: Then the sons of matter will perish; they will not be, henceforth.

canonical_statement: The true self is distinct from the physical body and requires 'holy garments' to remain untouched by material forces.

attributions.chapter: THE CONCEPT OF OUR GREAT POWER ( V I ,4 )
attributions.surface_quote: They have holy garments, which the fire cannot touch.

canonical_statement: Individual souls attain a state of existence characterized by reflection of the divine light.

attributions.chapter: THE CONCEPT OF OUR GREAT POWER ( V I ,4 )
attributions.surface_quote: They all have become as reflections in his light.

canonical_statement: The divine will is immanent within the souls of the holy.

attributions.chapter: THE CONCEPT OF OUR GREAT POWER ( V I ,4 )
attributions.surface_quote: They see him because of his will, which is in them.

canonical_statement: Souls currently undergoing purification are capable of transitioning into a state of purity.

attributions.chapter: THE CONCEPT OF OUR GREAT POWER ( V I ,4 )
attributions.surface_quote: He will release the souls that are being punished, and they will come to be in purity.

canonical_statement: Human existence is bifurcated between adherence to archontic law and the attainment of the unchangeable aeon.

attributions.chapter: THE CONCEPT OF OUR GREAT POWER ( V I ,4 )
attributions.surface_quote: We have acted according to our birth of the flesh... We also have come to be in the unchangeable aeon.

canonical_statement: The human soul is a composite entity consisting of three distinct forces: base passions, noble courage, and rational intellect.

attributions.chapter: THE CONCEPT OF OUR GREAT POWER ( V I ,4 )
attributions.surface_quote: human soul is likened to a trichotomous hybrid of different forces

canonical_statement: The human condition is characterized by an initial fall into the influence of base passions and animalistic impulses.

attributions.chapter: THE CONCEPT OF OUR GREAT POWER ( V I ,4 )
attributions.surface_quote: man's initial fall into the clutches of the evil beast and the lion

canonical_statement: Liberation of the soul requires the active rejection and subjugation of the lower, illusory images of the self.

attributions.chapter: THE CONCEPT OF OUR GREAT POWER ( V I ,4 )
attributions.surface_quote: directive to him to cast down and trample the images

canonical_statement: The soul possesses a rational nature that is distinct from the composite, beast-like images it assumes.

attributions.chapter: THE CONCEPT OF OUR GREAT POWER ( V I ,4 )
attributions.surface_quote: An image that has no likeness is the rationality of the soul.

canonical_statement: Human identity is composed of multiple, disparate animalistic forms that can be unified into a single complex image.

attributions.chapter: THE CONCEPT OF OUR GREAT POWER ( V I ,4 )
attributions.surface_quote: They all came down and they cast off forms and images. And they all became a single image.

canonical_statement: Perception is limited to externalized images, preventing the individual from recognizing the internal structure of the soul.

attributions.chapter: THE CONCEPT OF OUR GREAT POWER ( V I ,4 )
attributions.surface_quote: Unable to see the things inside him. But what is outside only is what he sees.

canonical_statement: Spiritual progress requires the active rejection and destruction of the beast-like images that constitute the lower self.

attributions.chapter: THE CONCEPT OF OUR GREAT POWER ( V I ,4 )
attributions.surface_quote: What is profitable for him is this: that he cast down every image of the evil beast.

canonical_statement: Human actions and thoughts possess a parasitic vitality that requires internal nourishment to persist.

attributions.chapter: THE NAG HAMMADI LIBRARY IN ENGLL H
attributions.surface_quote: within the man they take hold firmly... he nourishes them just like the farmer

canonical_statement: Injustice and strife are self-consuming forces that weaken the individual who engages in them.

attributions.chapter: THE NAG HAMMADI LIBRARY IN ENGLL H
attributions.surface_quote: with strife they devour each other among themselves

canonical_statement: The universe is structured as a series of concentric spheres, with the lower seven governed by planetary powers and the eighth and ninth representing the divine realm.

attributions.chapter: THE NAG HAMMADI LIBRARY IN ENGLL H
attributions.surface_quote: The eighth and the ninth indicate the eighth and ninth spheres surrounding the earth.

canonical_statement: Human souls must traverse the seven lower planetary spheres after death to reach the divine bliss of the higher spheres.

attributions.chapter: THE NAG HAMMADI LIBRARY IN ENGLL H
attributions.surface_quote: At death the soul would journey through the seven spheres... to reach the eighth.

canonical_statement: The higher spheres represent both post-mortem destinations and internal stages of spiritual development achievable during life.

attributions.chapter: THE NAG HAMMADI LIBRARY IN ENGLL H
attributions.surface_quote: The eighth and the ninth spheres can also indicate advanced stages of spiritual development.

canonical_statement: Spiritual progression requires the attainment of moral purity and the intellectual eradication of ignorance.

attributions.chapter: THE NAG HAMMADI LIBRARY IN ENGLL H
attributions.surface_quote: Attainment of purity of life and the banishing of ignorance by mastering knowledge.

canonical_statement: Universal mind is a distinct ontological level or state of consciousness accessible through initiation.

attributions.chapter: THE NAG HAMMADI LIBRARY IN ENGLL H
attributions.surface_quote: become the embodiment of universal mind, which is the ninth

canonical_statement: The individual soul achieves enlightenment by recognizing and merging with the universal mind.

attributions.chapter: THE NAG HAMMADI LIBRARY IN ENGLL H
attributions.surface_quote: experiences his own unity with universal mind

canonical_statement: Spiritual understanding is a generative power that can be transmitted from teacher to initiate.

attributions.chapter: THE NAG HAMMADI LIBRARY IN ENGLL H
attributions.surface_quote: the understanding dwells in you; in me (it is) as though the power were pregnant

canonical_statement: Divine emanations or powers are generated through a process analogous to biological procreation.

attributions.chapter: THE NAG HAMMADI LIBRARY IN ENGLL H
attributions.surface_quote: I gave birth to it (the power), as children are born.

canonical_statement: Individual entities originating from the same divine source share a fraternal relationship as offspring of that source.

attributions.chapter: THE NAG HAMMADI LIBRARY IN ENGLL H
attributions.surface_quote: I have many brothers, if I am to be numbered among the offspring.

canonical_statement: All human beings share a common origin from a single divine father.

attributions.chapter: THE DISCOURSE ON THE EIGHTH AND NINTH (V I , 6 )
attributions.surface_quote: recognize your brothers... because they come from the same father.

canonical_statement: Spiritual beings exist as forces that facilitate the development of other souls.

attributions.chapter: THE DISCOURSE ON THE EIGHTH AND NINTH (V I , 6 )
attributions.surface_quote: they exist as forces that grow other souls.

canonical_statement: Spiritual beings are inherently immortal.

attributions.chapter: THE DISCOURSE ON THE EIGHTH AND NINTH (V I , 6 )
attributions.surface_quote: they are spiritual ones... they are immortal.

canonical_statement: The beauty of the soul is a product of gradual edification and stages of wisdom.

attributions.chapter: THE DISCOURSE ON THE EIGHTH AND NINTH (V I , 6 )
attributions.surface_quote: beauty of the soul, the edification that came to you in stages.

canonical_statement: The attainment of higher spiritual states requires the total alignment of the individual's mind, heart, and soul.

attributions.chapter: THE DISCOURSE ON THE EIGHTH AND NINTH (V I , 6 )
attributions.surface_quote: pray to God with all our mind and all our heart and our soul

canonical_statement: Spiritual enlightenment or higher knowledge is a divine gift granted to the individual.

attributions.chapter: THE DISCOURSE ON THE EIGHTH AND NINTH (V I , 6 )
attributions.surface_quote: ask him that the gift of the eighth extend to us

canonical_statement: The universe is structured into hierarchical levels of reality, including an 'eighth' realm.

attributions.chapter: THE DISCOURSE ON THE EIGHTH AND NINTH (V I , 6 )
attributions.surface_quote: the gift of the eighth

canonical_statement: The divine will is the generative principle that provides form to substance and life to all entities.

attributions.chapter: THE DISCOURSE ON THE EIGHTH AND NINTH (V I , 6 )
attributions.surface_quote: His will begets life for the forms in every place. His nature gives form to substance.

canonical_statement: The universe derives its ensoulment from the unbegotten divine source.

attributions.chapter: THE DISCOURSE ON THE EIGHTH AND NINTH (V I , 6 )
attributions.surface_quote: From you the universe received soul.

canonical_statement: All begotten existence originates from the unbegotten, self-begotten divine source.

attributions.chapter: THE DISCOURSE ON THE EIGHTH AND NINTH (V I , 6 )
attributions.surface_quote: From you, the unbegotten one, the begotten one came into being.

canonical_statement: The divine is an invisible, self-contained reality accessible through silence.

attributions.chapter: THE DISCOURSE ON THE EIGHTH AND NINTH (V I , 6 )
attributions.surface_quote: He is perfect, the invisible God to whom one speaks in silence.

canonical_statement: Spiritual progress involves ascending through hierarchical stages of reality toward the Pleroma.

attributions.chapter: THE DISCOURSE ON THE EIGHTH AND NINTH (V I , 6 )
attributions.surface_quote: We have already advanced to the seventh... describe to ourselves the vision of the eighth and the ninth.

canonical_statement: The individual mind is capable of perceiving a higher, transcendent Mind that governs the soul.

attributions.chapter: THE DISCOURSE ON THE EIGHTH AND NINTH (V I , 6 )
attributions.surface_quote: I am Mind and I see another Mind, the one that moves the soul.

canonical_statement: The ultimate source of existence is a beginningless power that serves as the fountain of life.

attributions.chapter: THE DISCOURSE ON THE EIGHTH AND NINTH (V I , 6 )
attributions.surface_quote: I have found the beginning of the power that is above all powers.

canonical_statement: Self-realization involves the soul's transition from a state of forgetfulness to active awareness.

attributions.chapter: THE DISCOURSE ON THE EIGHTH AND NINTH (V I , 6 )
attributions.surface_quote: I see the one that moves me from pure forgetfulness.

canonical_statement: The ultimate reality, identified as Mind, transcends linguistic expression and conceptual interpretation.

attributions.chapter: THE DISCOURSE ON THE EIGHTH AND NINTH ( V I ,6 )
attributions.surface_quote: Language is not able to reveal this. Mind cannot be interpreted.

canonical_statement: The highest form of communion with the divine occurs through silent internal praise rather than spoken language.

attributions.chapter: THE DISCOURSE ON THE EIGHTH AND NINTH ( V I ,6 )
attributions.surface_quote: Sing a hymn in silence. Sing it while you are silent.

canonical_statement: The universe is sustained by a divine providence that provides life and spirit to all beings.

attributions.chapter: THE DISCOURSE ON THE EIGHTH AND NINTH ( V I ,6 )
attributions.surface_quote: There is no creature that will lack your life. By a spirit he gives rain.

canonical_statement: The structure of reality includes hierarchical realms, specifically the eighth and ninth, inhabited by souls and powers.

attributions.chapter: THE DISCOURSE ON THE EIGHTH AND NINTH ( V I ,6 )
attributions.surface_quote: I see the eighth and the souls that are in it and the angels.

canonical_statement: The ultimate divine source is the origin of light, truth, and the totality of existence.

attributions.chapter: THE DISCOURSE ON THE EIGHTH AND NINTH ( V I ,6 )
attributions.surface_quote: The begetter of light and truth, the object of man's quest.

canonical_statement: The individual consciousness functions as an instrument through which the divine spirit expresses itself.

attributions.chapter: THE DISCOURSE ON THE EIGHTH AND NINTH ( V I ,6 )
attributions.surface_quote: I am the instrument of your spirit; Mind is your plectrum.

canonical_statement: Divine wisdom and life are received through an internal, hidden name or essence.

attributions.chapter: THE DISCOURSE ON THE EIGHTH AND NINTH ( V I ,6 )
attributions.surface_quote: I call your name that is hidden within me.

canonical_statement: The attainment of divine knowledge requires submission to the law of God rather than the dictates of fate.

attributions.chapter: THE DISCOURSE ON THE EIGHTH AND NINTH ( V I ,6 )
attributions.surface_quote: They should submit to the law of God, without having transgressed at all.

canonical_statement: Access to sacred knowledge is contingent upon a prior spiritual initiation or divine begetting.

attributions.chapter: THE DISCOURSE ON THE EIGHTH AND NINTH ( V I ,6 )
attributions.surface_quote: He who will not be begotten at the start by God will not be able to read.

canonical_statement: Moral purity and the avoidance of shameful acts are prerequisites for the soul's progression toward immortality.

attributions.chapter: THE DISCOURSE ON THE EIGHTH AND NINTH ( V I ,6 )
attributions.surface_quote: pure within him... he advances and enters into the way of immortality.

canonical_statement: The structure of reality is hierarchical, consisting of distinct stages or realms, specifically the eighth and ninth levels of understanding.

attributions.chapter: THE DISCOURSE ON THE EIGHTH AND NINTH ( V I ,6 )
attributions.surface_quote: enters into the understanding of the eighth that reveals the ninth.

canonical_statement: The material elements and celestial rulers serve as witnesses or foundational authorities for sacred knowledge.

attributions.chapter: THE DISCOURSE ON THE EIGHTH AND NINTH ( V I ,6 )
attributions.surface_quote: swear by heaven and earth and fire and water and seven rulers of substance.

canonical_statement: The divine hierarchy consists of the unbegotten God, the self-begotten one, and the begotten one.

attributions.chapter: THE DISCOURSE ON THE EIGHTH A ND NINTH ( V I ,6 )
attributions.surface_quote: the unbegotten God and the self-begotten one and him who has been begotten

canonical_statement: The ultimate reality is defined as the perfect one that exists.

attributions.chapter: THE DISCOURSE ON THE EIGHTH A ND NINTH ( V I ,6 )
attributions.surface_quote: This is the perfect one who is

canonical_statement: Adherence to sacred oaths determines the nature of the individual's relationship with the divine.

attributions.chapter: THE DISCOURSE ON THE EIGHTH A ND NINTH ( V I ,6 )
attributions.surface_quote: those who keep the oath, God will be reconciled with them

canonical_statement: The acquisition of deifying knowledge is a transformative event that necessitates ritual expression.

attributions.chapter: THE DISCOURSE ON THE EIGHTH A ND NINTH ( V I ,6 )
attributions.surface_quote: gratitude of one who has received deifying knowledge

canonical_statement: Mystical knowledge is preserved and reinforced through communal cultic practices and shared visionary experiences.

attributions.chapter: THE DISCOURSE ON THE EIGHTH A ND NINTH ( V I ,6 )
attributions.surface_quote: community dedicated to the encouragement of the visionary experience

canonical_statement: The acquisition of divine knowledge transforms human consciousness into a divine state while still embodied.

attributions.surface_quote: while we were in the body, You have made us divine through Your knowledge.

canonical_statement: The ultimate reality is the source of all existence, functioning as the intellectual light and the womb of all creatures.

attributions.surface_quote: Womb of every creature... intellectual light.

canonical_statement: Human cognitive faculties such as mind, speech, and knowledge are gifts granted by the divine to facilitate the comprehension of the divine.

attributions.surface_quote: giving us mind, speech, and knowledge so that we may know You.

canonical_statement: The preservation of the soul's state depends upon the continuous maintenance of divine knowledge.

attributions.surface_quote: There is one petition that we ask: we would be preserved in knowledge.

canonical_statement: Spiritual transformation requires a reciprocal exchange of essence between two entities.

attributions.surface_quote: mystery experience requires an intimate interaction between two parties

canonical_statement: Knowledge and learning are the primary mechanisms for restraining passions and achieving immortality.

attributions.surface_quote: Man needs learning and knowledge to restrain harmful passions and to become good and immortal.

canonical_statement: Through the acquisition of knowledge, human beings transcend the ontological status of the gods by embodying both mortality and immortality.

attributions.surface_quote: man becomes better than the gods, since then he is both mortal and immortal.

canonical_statement: Deities are constructed by human consciousness in the image of human likeness.

attributions.surface_quote: men create gods according to human likenesses.

canonical_statement: The universe undergoes a cyclical process of birth and renewal initiated by the creator.

attributions.surface_quote: the final action of the creator god to end them and bring the universe to birth

canonical_statement: The restoration of the pious is determined by the eternal will of God manifest in the universe's design.

attributions.surface_quote: Restoration of the pious ones is founded upon the eternal will of God.

canonical_statement: The universe is hierarchically governed, with God presiding over the heavens and subordinate deities over other realms.

attributions.surface_quote: Heights of heaven are controlled by God. Other areas are controlled by other gods.

canonical_statement: Post-mortem existence involves the soul's separation from the body and subsequent judgment by a great daimon.

attributions.surface_quote: The soul separates from the body and goes to be judged by the great daimon.

canonical_statement: God is omnipresent, existing in and observing every location within the universe.

attributions.surface_quote: He is in every place, and he looks out over every place.

canonical_statement: The universe is inherently good and its governing forces are beneficent.

attributions.surface_quote: The universe is good and the demiurge and earth goddess are beneficent.

canonical_statement: The union of male and female principles is a sacred mystery representing a fundamental metaphysical interaction.

attributions.surface_quote: the mystery of intercourse is performed in secret... they are holy mysteries

canonical_statement: Ignorance of divine order is the root cause of the soul's corruption and emotional suffering.

attributions.surface_quote: if there is ignorance... the incurable passions persist in it

canonical_statement: Knowledge and learning are divine gifts provided to humanity to heal the soul of material passions.

attributions.surface_quote: knowledge of the things which are ordained is truly the healing of the passions

canonical_statement: God is not the source of human evil or suffering, as the means for spiritual correction are provided.

attributions.surface_quote: God is not the cause of these things, since he sent to men knowledge

canonical_statement: Humanity possesses a unique capacity for knowledge and learning not shared by other beings.

attributions.surface_quote: he granted to men alone knowledge and learning

canonical_statement: Human beings are ontologically derived from the realm of matter.

attributions.surface_quote: he took him from the region of matter

canonical_statement: The material composition of the human body serves as the source of emotional and sensory passions.

attributions.surface_quote: matter is involved in the creation of man, the passions are in it

canonical_statement: Mortality necessitates the consumption of external sustenance to maintain existence.

attributions.surface_quote: this living creature would not have existed in any other way except that he had taken this food

canonical_statement: Divine beings are composed of pure matter and possess inherent, non-acquired knowledge.

attributions.surface_quote: the gods, since they came into being out of a pure matter, do not need learning

canonical_statement: Humanity possesses a dual nature, simultaneously participating in both mortality and immortality.

attributions.surface_quote: he created a two-fold nature for him: the immortal and the mortal

canonical_statement: Learning and knowledge function as mechanisms to restrain passions and transcend mortal limitations.

attributions.surface_quote: he perfected them in order that by means of these things he might restrain passions

canonical_statement: Humanity possesses the creative capacity to generate divine entities, mirroring the creative act of the Father.

attributions.surface_quote: man too, this mortal, earthly, living creature... also himself creates gods

canonical_statement: Human beings possess the ontological capacity to generate or manifest divine entities.

attributions.surface_quote: Not only is he god, but he also creates gods.

canonical_statement: The human condition is inherently blessed due to the possession of creative power.

attributions.surface_quote: man is blessed, since he has enjoyed this great power.

canonical_statement: Humanity creates divine entities in its own image, mirroring the process by which God created humanity in the divine image.

attributions.surface_quote: man on earth creates gods according to his likeness

canonical_statement: Physical objects created by humans can be imbued with soul, breath, and the capacity to perform divine functions.

attributions.surface_quote: those who have soul and breadth... bring about these great events

canonical_statement: Specific geographic locations can serve as terrestrial manifestations or temples for celestial forces.

attributions.surface_quote: Egypt is the image of heaven

canonical_statement: The presence of divinity within a terrestrial domain is contingent upon human religious activity and can be withdrawn.

attributions.surface_quote: all divinity will leave Egypt and will flee upward to heaven

canonical_statement: The physical world is a divine, multi-faceted energy that can lose its status as an object of reverence.

attributions.surface_quote: the beautiful world of God... the energy that possesses goodness

canonical_statement: Human perception of reality is subject to cyclical degradation, where light and life are rejected in favor of darkness and death.

attributions.surface_quote: Darkness will be preferred to light and death will be preferred to life.

canonical_statement: The soul and the nature of immortality are subject to objective truth, regardless of whether human society deems them vanity.

attributions.surface_quote: concerning the soul... they will be considered ridiculous, but they will also be thought of as vanity.

canonical_statement: The presence of non-human entities (wicked angels) influences human behavior and moral trajectory.

attributions.surface_quote: The wicked angels will remain among men... and lead them into wicked things.

canonical_statement: The physical world is a singular, unified vision that can fragment into a burden when disconnected from the divine.

attributions.surface_quote: It has become neither a single thing nor a vision. But it is in danger of becoming a burden.

canonical_statement: The material world undergoes a cyclical process of decay and senility.

attributions.surface_quote: Such is the senility of the world

canonical_statement: The divine creator intervenes to restore order when the world falls into chaos and impiety.

attributions.surface_quote: the Lord... when he looked upon the things that happened, established his design

canonical_statement: Human morality and the stability of the physical world are intrinsically linked.

attributions.surface_quote: the earth will not be stable... atheism, dishonor, and the disregard of noble words

canonical_statement: The divine will is identical to the divine nature, and both are eternal and without beginning.

attributions.surface_quote: the will of God has no beginning, even as his nature

canonical_statement: God is complete and lacks nothing; therefore, divine will is the affirmation of what is already possessed.

attributions.surface_quote: he does not will what he has from deficiency... he wills what he fully has

canonical_statement: The material world is an image of the supreme Good.

attributions.surface_quote: the good world is an image of the Good One

canonical_statement: The supreme deity exists beyond the physical heavens and is incorporeal.

attributions.surface_quote: he is in every place... and he is free from the body

canonical_statement: Death is defined as the dissolution of the physical body and its constituent numerical structure.

attributions.surface_quote: death occurs, which is the dissolution of the labors of the body

canonical_statement: Death is defined as the dissolution of the physical body and the cessation of sensory perception.

attributions.surface_quote: death: the dissolution of the body and the destruction of the sensation of the body.

canonical_statement: A divine overseer or judge exists between earth and heaven to evaluate the soul's conduct upon death.

attributions.surface_quote: God has appointed him to be overseer or judge over the souls of men.

canonical_statement: Post-mortem existence is determined by the moral character developed during one's earthly life.

attributions.surface_quote: he will examine him in regard to the character that he has developed.

canonical_statement: Souls that lived evilly are suspended between heaven and earth and subjected to elemental torment.

attributions.surface_quote: he grasps him... and throws him down so that he is suspended... and is punished.

canonical_statement: The soul is distinct from the body and survives the body's dissolution.

attributions.surface_quote: when the soul comes forth from the body

canonical_statement: The ontological status and moral conditions of entities in the earthly realm differ fundamentally from those in the transcendent realm.

attributions.surface_quote: For those who are here are not like those who are there.

canonical_statement: Souls burdened by excessive evil are restricted from celestial movement and are instead confined to painful, daemonic regions.

attributions.surface_quote: Souls filled with much evil will not come and go in the air.

canonical_statement: Daimons responsible for human suffering are not manifestations of divine or rational human souls, but originate from a source of pure evil.

attributions.surface_quote: They are not from a divine soul, nor from a rational soul of man.

canonical_statement: The universe is fundamentally constituted by three distinct, primordial principles: Light, Darkness, and Spirit.

attributions.surface_quote: the universe as rooted in three principles... Light Infinite... Darkness... the Spirit.

canonical_statement: Primordial harmony is maintained by the absolute separation and non-interaction of the three fundamental principles.

attributions.surface_quote: harmony... derives from the fact that each of those roots reigns in itself.

canonical_statement: The material universe is a construct created by divine intervention to facilitate the salvation of the Mind.

attributions.surface_quote: the Savior provokes the creation of the universe... initiating the salvation of the Mind.

canonical_statement: The interaction between distinct metaphysical principles results in the loss or transfer of essence between them.

attributions.surface_quote: The Spirit reveals himself to Darkness and by doing so loses a part of his light.

canonical_statement: The universe is a unified, interconnected entity where all parts are contained within the whole.

attributions.surface_quote: All things are one, and the one is all things.

canonical_statement: The divine essence permeates all material forms, rendering the cosmos a living, ensouled entity.

attributions.surface_quote: The world is a living being, filled with life.

canonical_statement: Time is a cyclical process governed by the movement and renewal of celestial bodies.

attributions.surface_quote: Time is measured by the movement of the stars.

canonical_statement: The material world is generated through the interaction between the Mind and Nature, resulting in distinct ontological spheres.

attributions.surface_quote: Darkness... has intercourse with the Womb and ejaculates the Mind.

canonical_statement: Humanity is divided into distinct classes based on the presence and origin of spiritual components like Mind, Thought, and Faith.

attributions.surface_quote: mankind in fact includes two classes of redeemed: the noetics... and pneumatics.

canonical_statement: Nature actively seeks to contain or destroy the pneumatic seed to maintain its own order.

attributions.surface_quote: In order to detain the light of Faith and to destroy the pneumatic race, Nature plans to cause a flood.

canonical_statement: The ultimate destiny of the pneumatic soul is to return to and repose within the Unbegotten Spirit.

attributions.surface_quote: they will bear the universal testimony and will repose in the place of the Unbegotten Spirit.

canonical_statement: The material soul is a byproduct of the interaction between winds and demons, lacking the divine particle of Mind.

attributions.surface_quote: The winds and the demons have intercourse... and give birth to all sorts of impurity, that is, the material souls.

canonical_statement: Material elements like water possess an inherent impurity that functions to entrap spiritual light.

attributions.surface_quote: water - a primordial impure power, which... tries to keep men prisoner

canonical_statement: The soul's return to its origin requires specific knowledge or passwords to bypass planetary spheres.

attributions.surface_quote: passwords which will allow them to pass... through the planetary spheres

canonical_statement: The crucifixion of the terrestrial body is an allegorical event signifying the ontological separation of light from darkness.

attributions.surface_quote: crucifixion... brings out the division between light and darkness

canonical_statement: Humanity is divided into distinct spiritual categories, such as pneumatics and noetics, each with different post-mortem destinations.

attributions.surface_quote: pneumatics ascend to the place of the Unbegotten Spirit; noetics... ascend to Hymen

canonical_statement: The human intellect or consciousness is capable of detaching from the physical body to perceive higher realms.

attributions.surface_quote: My thought which was in my body snatched me away from my race.

canonical_statement: The physical body is characterized as a state of darkness, distinct from the light of higher existence.

attributions.surface_quote: my thought separated from the body of darkness

canonical_statement: Higher reality is defined by the presence of light and the absence of earthly forms.

attributions.surface_quote: I saw no earthly likeness, but there was light.

canonical_statement: The primordial structure of reality consists of three distinct roots: Light, Darkness, and an intermediary Spirit.

attributions.surface_quote: There was Light and Darkness and there was Spirit between them.

canonical_statement: Darkness is characterized by a lack of perception and the illusory belief in its own supremacy.

attributions.surface_quote: The crookedness of the Darkness was lack of perception, namely that there is no one above him.

canonical_statement: Individual consciousness or 'mind' can be separated from the root of Darkness through the intervention of Light.

attributions.surface_quote: The Darkness came up wrapped in vile ignorance, in order that the mind might separate from him.

canonical_statement: Evil or disorder arises from the attempt to equate an inferior state with a superior, infinite reality.

attributions.surface_quote: He wanted to do an impossible thing, and it did not take place.

canonical_statement: Individual consciousness is an emanation or ray of a singular, infinite, and incorruptible primordial Light.

attributions.surface_quote: I am the son of the incorruptible, infinite Light. I am the ray of the universal Light.

canonical_statement: The material world and its structures are formed through the interaction and separation of chaotic fire, darkness, and water.

attributions.surface_quote: The mind drew the chaotic fire... from the midst of the Darkness and the water.

canonical_statement: Nature functions as a generative womb that captures and shapes the mind, attempting to contain or expel it.

attributions.surface_quote: When Nature had taken to herself the mind... every likeness took shape in her.

canonical_statement: The division of Nature into four parts is a necessary process to purge the chaotic fire and empty the material realm.

attributions.surface_quote: In order that Nature might become empty of the chaotic fire, then immediately Nature was divided into four parts.

canonical_statement: The mind is an entity distinct from Nature and its chaotic, dark elements.

attributions.surface_quote: the mind was in the midst of Nature and the dark power

canonical_statement: Nature is a divisible structure that can be partitioned to facilitate the liberation of the mind.

attributions.surface_quote: Nature was divided, according to my will, in order that the mind may return

canonical_statement: The mind possesses an inherent power that can be obscured or sequestered by dark, material roots.

attributions.surface_quote: the mind may return to its power which the dark root had taken

canonical_statement: There exists a middle region within the structure of Nature where the mind can reside.

attributions.surface_quote: The mind went into the midst of the power - this was the middle region

canonical_statement: The material world and its structures are characterized as clouds of fire and darkness, representing a state of separation from the infinite light.

attributions.surface_quote: The Hymen of Nature was a cloud which cannot be grasped; it is a great fire.

canonical_statement: The mind is a construct that emerges from the interaction between the spirit and the material forces of nature.

attributions.surface_quote: Because of this the mind took shape. Its repose was shattered.

canonical_statement: The spirit possesses an inherent capacity to cast off material burdens through the force of astonishment or recognition of its own nature.

attributions.surface_quote: The force of his Astonishment cast off the burden.

canonical_statement: The root of nature is inherently blind and burdensome, functioning as a source of darkness and confusion.

attributions.surface_quote: The root of Nature, which was below, was crooked, since it is burdensome and harmful.

canonical_statement: The ultimate reality is an infinite, exalted light that acts as the source and sustainer of the spirit's purity.

attributions.surface_quote: Thou art the root of the Light. Thy hidden form has appeared.

canonical_statement: The infinite Light descends into material nature temporarily to purge impurity and expose the darkness of nature.

attributions.chapter: THE PARAPHRASE OF SHEM ( V I I ,7 )
attributions.surface_quote: Light of the infinite Spirit came down to a feeble nature for a short time.

canonical_statement: The Spirit possesses an inherent power to rise above darkness and material burdens when granted greatness by the infinite Light.

attributions.chapter: THE PARAPHRASE OF SHEM ( V I I ,7 )
attributions.surface_quote: The Spirit arose by his own power... to depart from the whole burden of Darkness.

canonical_statement: The separation of the mind from darkness is a necessary consequence of the inability of darkness to contain its own evil.

attributions.chapter: THE PARAPHRASE OF SHEM ( V I I ,7 )
attributions.surface_quote: If the Darkness had been able to bear up under his evil, the mind would not have separated.

canonical_statement: The perfect Light exists as a transcendent entity superior to both the Spirit and the Darkness.

attributions.chapter: THE PARAPHRASE OF SHEM ( V I I ,7 )
attributions.surface_quote: I am the perfect Light which is above the Spirit and the Darkness.

canonical_statement: Material nature is characterized by division and impurity, serving as a foil for the manifestation of the Majesty.

attributions.chapter: THE PARAPHRASE OF SHEM ( V I I ,7 )
attributions.surface_quote: Through the division of Nature the Majesty wished to be covered with honor.

canonical_statement: The divine light is ontologically inseparable from the unbegotten Spirit.

attributions.chapter: THE PARAPHRASE OF SHEM ( V I I ,7 )
attributions.surface_quote: the image of the Light is inseparable from the unbegotten Spirit.

canonical_statement: Nature is composed of fragmented likenesses derived from chaotic hylic fire.

attributions.chapter: THE PARAPHRASE OF SHEM ( V I I ,7 )
attributions.surface_quote: every likeness into which Nature had divided is a power of the chaotic fire.

canonical_statement: The Spirit and the mind require protection from the burden and toil of the material realm.

attributions.chapter: THE PARAPHRASE OF SHEM ( V I I ,7 )
attributions.surface_quote: the mind and the whole light of the Spirit might be protected from every burden.

canonical_statement: The individual consciousness is a manifestation of an infinite, universal Thought.

attributions.chapter: THE PARAPHRASE OF SHEM ( V I I ,7 )
attributions.surface_quote: my likeness is from my infinite Thought.

canonical_statement: The material realm is inherently incapable of sustaining the presence of pure divine light.

attributions.chapter: THE PARAPHRASE OF SHEM ( V I I ,7 )
attributions.surface_quote: the cloud was disturbed, and it was not able to bear my likeness.

canonical_statement: The Spirit originates within a state of primordial silence.

attributions.surface_quote: the Spirit which exists in the silence

canonical_statement: Ignorance of the universal Spirit causes existential distress and confusion.

attributions.surface_quote: They were troubled since they did not know where they were.

canonical_statement: The material world is a product of separation from the primordial light.

attributions.surface_quote: It was separated from the light by the cloud of the silence.

canonical_statement: The manifestation of the Spirit acts as a salvific force for entities trapped in darkness.

attributions.surface_quote: the light of the Spirit began to save itself from the frightful water

canonical_statement: Entities regain their original perfection when reconnected with universal Thought.

attributions.surface_quote: It was filled with the universal Thought... It received form in its root.

canonical_statement: The material world originated from a state of forgetfulness and deception.

attributions.surface_quote: deceived by the fire of darkness

canonical_statement: The physical elements of fire and water are inherently antagonistic and harmful when combined.

attributions.surface_quote: fire mixed with the water in order that the waters might become harmful

canonical_statement: The natural world derives its strength and vitality from the indwelling presence of Spirit.

attributions.surface_quote: Nature took to herself the power of fire. She became strong because of the light of the Spirit

canonical_statement: The material manifestation of Nature is a distorted, monstrous reflection of a higher reality.

attributions.surface_quote: Her likeness appeared in the water in the form of a frightful beast

canonical_statement: Light and spirit can become trapped or burdened within the material darkness of nature.

attributions.surface_quote: the light of the Spirit which was burdened

canonical_statement: The material realm (the womb) is fundamentally distinct from the light and lacks inherent illumination.

attributions.surface_quote: the light... although this was not hers

canonical_statement: The root of material existence is rendered inert or idle by the influence of the Light.

attributions.surface_quote: her root was made idle by the likeness of the Light

canonical_statement: Individual consciousness or light can become lost and require divine intervention to regain orientation.

attributions.surface_quote: if thy goodness does not establish me, I do not know where I am

canonical_statement: Higher entities utilize garments or manifestations to interact with lower regions of existence.

attributions.surface_quote: I honored my garment which has three forms

canonical_statement: The individual essence is fundamentally immortal, despite appearing mortal within the material realm.

attributions.surface_quote: mortal appeared to him, but they were all immortal things

canonical_statement: The soul must descend into chaotic, material nature to liberate trapped light.

attributions.surface_quote: I went down to chaos to save the whole light from it

canonical_statement: The manifestation of power in the material world requires the adoption of specific, formless vestments.

attributions.surface_quote: I put on another garment of fire which has no form

canonical_statement: Darkness and material nature are necessary instruments for the operation of spiritual power.

attributions.surface_quote: without the power of darkness I could not oppose Nature

canonical_statement: The material world is a construct prepared by the Spirit to serve as a temporary vessel or rest for light.

attributions.surface_quote: it had been prepared for me as a garment and a rest by the Spirit

canonical_statement: The material world is a product of the interaction between the Spirit and the chaotic, unclean nature of darkness.

attributions.surface_quote: Nature arose since she possesses of the power of the Spirit and the Darkness.

canonical_statement: The physical universe was intentionally structured to facilitate the liberation of the Spirit from bondage.

attributions.surface_quote: In order that the whole light might rise up.

canonical_statement: The mind or spirit can be temporarily obscured or 'dried' by the influence of the material womb.

attributions.surface_quote: The wrathful womb came up and made the mind dry.

canonical_statement: The material realm is inherently blind and requires the intervention of a higher consciousness to manifest order.

attributions.surface_quote: In order that the deeds of Nature might be condemned, since she is blind.

canonical_statement: The creation of heaven and earth is a secondary process resulting from the interaction of Spirit with the chaotic fire of Nature.

attributions.surface_quote: The heaven was created. And from the foam of the heaven the earth came into being.

canonical_statement: The material world is a product of the interaction between light, fire, and darkness.

attributions.surface_quote: garment of fire arose in the midst of the cloud of Nature

canonical_statement: The physical realm is destined to be stripped of its inherent spiritual powers over time.

attributions.surface_quote: power remained in order that it might be in Nature until all powers are taken

canonical_statement: The material world (Nature) is a feminine entity that generates existence through internal and external interaction.

attributions.surface_quote: she obeyed the will of the Spirit that she might be brought to naught

canonical_statement: The current state of the world is characterized by a mixture of spiritual light and dark, demonic forces.

attributions.surface_quote: they begot winds and demons and the power which is from the fire

canonical_statement: The liberation of spiritual power from material forms is a necessary process governed by an appointed time.

attributions.surface_quote: it is necessary that also the power which is in Hades will be completed

canonical_statement: The mind originates from the interaction between the unbegotten Spirit and the mind itself.

attributions.surface_quote: The strong power of the mind came into being from the mind and the unbegotten Spirit.

canonical_statement: The soul is a product of darkness and unchastity, serving as a burden to the light.

attributions.surface_quote: For the soul is a work of unchastity and an object of scorn to the thought of Light.

canonical_statement: Human existence involves a mixture of demonic elements and a divine thought from the Light.

attributions.surface_quote: You possess a share of the winds and the demons, and a thought from the Light.

canonical_statement: Liberation is achieved by detaching the consciousness from the soul and aligning with the thought of Light.

attributions.surface_quote: It is blessedness if one departs from the soul to go to the thought of the Light.

canonical_statement: Nature is a temporary, corruptible structure destined for destruction at the end of time.

attributions.surface_quote: At the end of time, when Nature will be destroyed.

canonical_statement: The material world and Nature are constructs designed to exhaust and eventually nullify the influence of darkness.

attributions.surface_quote: I made the womb... that I might be able to bring (it) to naught.

canonical_statement: The human soul or light-particle is capable of existing independently of the physical body and material necessity.

attributions.surface_quote: without body and necessity it is protected from every body of Darkness

canonical_statement: The ultimate state of the enlightened consciousness is a return to rest within the unbegotten Spirit.

attributions.surface_quote: they shall rest in the unbegotten Spirit without grief.

canonical_statement: Physical reality is a product of a deliberate disturbance within the divine will intended to empty Nature of its power.

attributions.surface_quote: the disturbance which occurred at my wish happened in order that Nature might become empty.

canonical_statement: Human consciousness is capable of receiving divine revelation through the internal faculty of thought.

attributions.surface_quote: Her thought will be taken and given to you with a consciousness of light.

canonical_statement: The material world and human existence originate from the mixture of darkness, fire, power, and light.

attributions.surface_quote: in the place of the Darkness, and the fire... that human beings came into existence.

canonical_statement: The capacity for spiritual perception is not inherent in all human beings.

attributions.surface_quote: Being from the Spirit... my eye, exists not in every man.

canonical_statement: The physical world is governed and influenced by demonic forces, winds, and stars.

attributions.surface_quote: For without wind and star nothing happens upon the earth.

canonical_statement: Ignorance is the fundamental state of the material nature, leading to the creation of deceptive forms.

attributions.surface_quote: And in her ignorance... she granted the demons and the winds a star each.

canonical_statement: The ultimate liberation involves the separation of light from darkness and the acquisition of spiritual thought.

attributions.surface_quote: the night and the day will be separated... acquire the thought of the light.

canonical_statement: The ultimate state of rest for the soul is union with the unbegotten Spirit.

attributions.surface_quote: They will rest with a pure conscience in the place of their repose.

canonical_statement: The material world and its phenomena are governed by a base, demonic nature.

attributions.surface_quote: The demon who appeared in the union of Nature with many faces.

canonical_statement: Spiritual light can be extracted or separated from the bondage of material elements.

attributions.surface_quote: I have taken the light of the Spirit from the frightful water.

canonical_statement: All cosmic powers, authorities, and directions are contained within the structure of Nature.

attributions.surface_quote: All the powers and authorities, you are in Nature.

canonical_statement: The manifestation of spiritual truth in the world necessarily triggers conflict with demonic forces.

attributions.surface_quote: When he appears in the world, evil passions will arise.

canonical_statement: The human spirit is an entity of light currently trapped within the material world, subjected to the influence of demonic and celestial powers.

attributions.chapter: THE PARAPHRASE OF SHEM ( V I I ,7 )
attributions.surface_quote: the power of the Spirit may cross, she who has been cast in the world

canonical_statement: The material world and the body are products of darkness and are fundamentally unclean or inferior to the Light.

attributions.chapter: THE PARAPHRASE OF SHEM ( V I I ,7 )
attributions.surface_quote: Do not let your thought have dealings with the fire and the body of Darkness

canonical_statement: The physical universe, including stars and demonic powers, contains a fragmented or stolen particle of the divine Spirit.

attributions.chapter: THE PARAPHRASE OF SHEM ( V I I ,7 )
attributions.surface_quote: the powers and the authorities, the demons and the stars, these possessed a particle of fire

canonical_statement: The divine essence manifests through various emanations or 'garments' that bridge the gap between the transcendent Light and the chaotic material realm.

attributions.chapter: THE PARAPHRASE OF SHEM ( V I I ,7 )
attributions.surface_quote: And the likeness is my honored garment... my invincible garment which I wore in Hades

canonical_statement: Human salvation is achieved by separating one's consciousness from the influence of the material 'dark wind' and aligning with the divine Light.

attributions.chapter: THE PARAPHRASE OF SHEM ( V I I ,7 )
